claims: Open the camera app on your smartphone.
Point the tip of the TV remote directly at the phone camera lens.
Press any button on the remote while looking at the phone screen.
If you see a flashing light or purple glow on the screen, the remote is sending a signal.

claims.text: You can check if a remote is sending a signal by opening your phone camera, pointing the front of the remote at the lens, and pressing a button to look for a light on the screen.
